newsitem.title: UK: Bass merger seen delayed by election - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bass merger seen delayed by election - paper.

text.p: A government ruling on the acquisition by brewing-to-leisure group Bass Plc of Carlsberg-Tetley is expected to be delayed until after the British general election on May 1, the Financial Times said on Monday.

Although the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC) would deliver its findings to Trade Secretary Ian Lang on Monday, he was likely to refrain from making a ruling on the 200 million stg deal, the paper said.
The case is likely to be the first MMC referral to be dealt with by the new government after the election.
